## What's new

- **Accept intended warnings:** in the Compatibility check, "Accept as intended" takes a warning out of the check and its counts for that map. This includes the automatic checks after saving.
  - "Accepted (N)" at the top lists them with their full text and fix buttons.
  - "Un-accept" puts one back.
- **Choose between two copies of a tile library:** when a map loads two DT1s with the same tile numbers (an original and a copy), the game picks between them at random on every cell, so a few cells show the other copy, often in odd colours. The "loaded twice" warning now has "Compare the copies and choose…".
  - It shows the same tiles from each copy side by side.
  - Keep the one that looks right, and the other is taken off the map and out of its level's Dt1Mask.
